                                                                                
 Usage: danvas [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                      
                                                                                
 Unified Canvas operations CLI.                                                 
                                                                                
 Use this for day-to-day course work: discover courses, export rosters, create  
 or audit assignments, move submission files, post grades, and score            
 discussions. Canvas-changing commands plan by default and require --apply. It  
 intentionally does not manage archival ledger/history data.                    
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --version                     Show the danvas version and exit.              │
│ --install-completion          Install completion for the current shell.      │
│ --show-completion             Show completion for the current shell, to copy │
│                               it or customize the installation.              │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ init           Create .danvas/config.toml and .danvas/course.json for a      │
│                Canvas course project.                                        │
│ refresh        Refresh .danvas/course.json from Canvas using --course-id or  │
│                .danvas/config.toml. Optional endpoint failures produce an    │
│                explicit partial snapshot.                                    │
│ status         Report Canvas-vs-local course state from the snapshot and     │
│                local sources. Read-only.                                     │
│ courses        Export active courses visible to the authenticated Canvas     │
│                user. The CSV is course-internal and is not automatically     │
│                safe to publish.                                              │
│ roster         Export active course enrollments to a roster CSV for later    │
│                grade/feedback matching.                                      │
│ assignments    Create assignments from Markdown sources or export assignment │
│                metadata for review.                                          │
│ auth           Inspect Canvas authentication configuration without printing  │
│                secrets.                                                      │
│ gradebook      Check Canvas gradebook exports and audit final-score setup.   │
│ quiz           Analyze Canvas Classic Quiz/Survey student-analysis CSV       │
│                exports.                                                      │
│ submissions    Download submitted media/attachments or upload per-student    │
│                feedback files.                                               │
│ grades         Safely post, clear, and verify CSV grades/comments with       │
│                private readback evidence.                                    │
│ discussions    Create, verify, export, update, or score Canvas discussions.  │
│ announcements  Create/export course announcements and filtered instructor    │
│                replies.                                                      │
│ pages          Render, inspect, sync, create, update, and verify Canvas      │
│                Pages.                                                        │
│ files          Inventory Canvas course Files and compare them to local       │
│                course files.                                                 │
│ recordings     Discover and download course recording transcripts/captions.  │
│ reports        List and inspect generated .danvas report runs.               │
│ sources        Validate local Canvas-facing authored sources without Canvas  │
│                access.                                                       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
